Chesterfield is the largest suburban county in the Richmond region at nearly 400,000 residents, with Route 288, I-95 and Route 360 framing the growth and Midlothian, Chester and the western county absorbing most of the rooftops. Industrial and data demand centers on Meadowville Technology Park near the I-295 interchange, while water and sewer capacity, school capacity and a slower rezoning path in the built out northern county are the practical limits.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: November 8, 2026
